changes.text: Vehicle Speed Modifier fixed — vehicles and trains no longer shoot off at full speed with no control. Speed now follows your throttle, S brakes, and releasing the throttle lets you coast
Fast Ladder fixed — you now actually climb at the set Ladder Speed instead of only the animation going fast. Move forward to go up, back to go down, release to stop
New Favorites tab — pin the features you use most. Tap ➕ Manage Favorites, search, and tap a feature to star it
Smarter search — multi-word, typo tolerant, ranked results, extra keywords, and tab filters like /esp
Custom Theme Creator — build your own theme with Accent, Background and Text colors, copy a theme code and share it (Settings tab)
Memory Cleaner — manual and automatic memory cleanup with a timer (Optimize tab)
Phantom now re-runs by itself after Server Hop or Rejoin (always on, no setup needed)
AI Chat faster and more reliable — animated thinking indicator, timeouts with automatic retry, and quicker answers for normal questions
New UI Styles — Folio and Ember interfaces added. Open Settings, scroll to UI Style and pick one from the list
Ember UI — top tab bar layout, ON/OFF block switches, tap any section header to fold it, and it auto-fits small phone screens
Smooth animations on all 3 UIs — menu pop-in, tab and row transitions, tap ripples, bouncy switches. Turn them off anytime in Settings > UI Animations for max FPS
Optimized for low-end devices — LOD Mode, Anti-Fling, ESP overlays and visual effects now use far less CPU and memory
Memory leak fixes — changing theme or reloading no longer stacks old loops and connections
Fling V2 — New R6 & R15 compatible fling engine (Selected Player, All Players)
Loop Kill V2 — Continuously runs Fling V2 on the selected target
Anti-CFrame Teleport Compatibility — No longer conflicts with or blocks Fling V2's movement
Anti-Fling — Blocks other players from flinging your character. State saves and auto-enables on re-execute
Anti-CFrame Teleport — Prevents the server from force-teleporting your character's position
Instant Interact — Removes hold delay from all ProximityPrompts so you can interact instantly
Show Invisible Walls — Reveals all hidden parts in the workspace (toggle off to re-hide)
Phantom AI v1.3 — Upgraded AI model with improved accuracy, speed and knowledge
Phantom AI — Built-in AI assistant accessible from the AI tab
Hot Reload Fix — Re-executing the script now cleanly unloads the old instance and reloads fresh without needing to re-enter the key
Info Tab Fixed — Game name, uptime, and player count now live-update correctly every second
Accessory Collision Fix — Accessories no longer physically collide after re-execution
Silent Fling — Flings nearby players with no visible spin — rotation resets client-side after each pulse
Custom Zoom Persistence — Zoom toggle now saves and restores state automatically on re-execution
